spans.s:
m. (-सः)
An actor in female apparel.
E.
भ्रु for भ्रू an eyebrow, कुसि or कुशि to shine or speak, aff. अच्; hence also भ्रुकुंश, भ्रूकुंस, &c.

m. (-सः)
A male actor in female apparel.
E.
भ्रू the eyebrow, कुसि to speak or shine, aff. अच्; also from कुशि, भ्रूकुंश; this word is variously written भ्रुकुंश or भ्रुकुंस, भृकुंश or भृकुंस, and भ्रकुंश or भ्रकुंस.

f. (-टिः-टी)
A frown.
E.
भ्रु for भ्र an eye-brow, कुट to make crooked, इन् aff.: see भ्रूकुटि.

f. (-टिः-टी)
A frown, a look of displeasure.
E.
भ्रू the brow, कुट to be curved, aff. इन्, and ङीप् optionally added; it is also written variously, like the last, and occurs भ्रुकुटि, भृकुटि, or भ्रकुटि.

r. 1st cl. (भ्रुडति)
1 To cover.
2 To collect.

f. (भ्रूः)
An eye-brow.
E.
भ्रम to turn round, Uṇādi aff. डू.

m. (-पः)
A frown.
E.
भ्रू, and क्षेप throwing.

r. 10th cl. (भ्रूणयते)
1 To hope, to trust.
2 To confide, to be without doubt.
3 To wish for, to desire.

m. (-णः)
The embryo or fœtus, a child.
E.
भ्रूण to hope, to fear, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं)
Producing or causing abortion, who or what does so.
E.
भ्रूण, and घ्न what destroys.

f. (-त्या)
1 Murder of the fœtus, procuring or causing abortion.
2 Any sin equally heinous.
E.
भ्रूण, and हत्या killing.

mf. (-हा-घ्नी)
1 One who occasions or procures abortion.
2 The murderer of a Brahman.
E.
भ्रूण the embryo, (or any thing of which the death is equally heinous,) and हन् who kills.

m. (-ङ्गः)
A frown.
E.
भ्रू the brow, भङ्ग a breaking, a bending.
